files.summary: Owner-mirrored H19-5 raster thinned by deterministic Poisson-disk dotting to 44,090 pixels (73% of the 0.2477-labelled mirror; 36% of H19-5). Conditional on unverified owner-reported score anchors, the H28 model estimates DTI 0.2510 and this file is its best point in the tested dot_thin(H19-5, d) sweep (d=1.8–4.0 px); this is a model output, not a competition score. The model-implied 12,691 truth count and 1.85-px concentration are fitted latent parameters, not verified hidden labels. In the 2026-10-25 prompt, this content id (e56ea318af89 / 91eae1ca) is listed with an unverified owner-reported score of 0.2600, and pixel-exact forensics proves GEMSDOE28 r1 (0.2708) is D2.8 & (d(cat)>1 px) and GEMSDOE32 H33-2-B2 (0.2778) is D2.8 & (d(cat)>2 px). It has not demonstrated a win over a comparable same-run holdout best and remains unscored/not slot-approved; the historical 0.152003389 comparator does not reproduce (IR-25-COMPARATOR-DRIFT).

files.title: Unique GEMSDOE25 GeoTIFF: H31-1 Tip-Preserved Flank-Shielded Sub-Scarp Concordance (sapd2.4)
files.summary: Genuinely unique GeoTIFF trained from scratch in GEMSDOE25 (H31-1 arm M1_C1: families BDE + H26 add-ons + H27_tip + H31_subscarp_concord + H31_offflank_tip_halo, emitted via Hessian ridge NMS -> tip-preserved lateral-flank shield d(catalogue)>2.5 px or H27_tip>=0.05 -> top 3.5% -> score-ordered Poisson-disk dotting at min_dist=2.4 px; 49,041 emitted dots, 0 on catalogue, 0 within 100 m of catalogue, only 432 tip-cone dots in 100–200 m). Passes all 16 format checks, the Protocol Rule 4 Leakage Canary (max standalone feature AUC 0.8386 <= 0.90), and the Protocol Rule 1 Duplicate-Lane check against 57 registry/focus rasters (max surface Spearman 0.1826 <= 0.90; max dotted/focus 3-px overlap 0.6544 <= 0.70, and only 0.3183 vs GEMSDOE32 0.2778). On the spatially-blocked hide-and-recover holdout, screen (draws 10,11) PASSED with HOLDOUT-DTI 0.153199 (evaluator=gems25.holdout.v1.2-buffered-4quad-pooled-dti, withheld_positives=22317, 95% CI [0.132707, 0.173690]) (4-fold mean 0.154190 > historical 0.152003389, paired gain +0.003384 in 3/4 folds, catalogue-hugging reduced -0.0243). Fresh-draw confirmation (draws 12,13) achieved HOLDOUT-DTI 0.144941 (evaluator=gems25.holdout.v1.2-buffered-4quad-pooled-dti, withheld_positives=22299, 95% CI [0.119601, 0.170282]) (+0.003848 pooled gain; 3/4 folds positive vs M0_C0 and 3/4 vs CTRL_NO_TIP, Factor C positive in 8/8 screen+confirm fold-blocks), but hit 2/4 folds against the strict pointwise max of the two controls (paired gain +0.001558). This holdout measurement is not a competition score; because the strict 3/4 pointwise-max confirmation gate over the comparable same-run holdout best did not pass (verdict: negative) and weekly slot selection is a separate selector step, this file is unscored and not slot-approved.
